description: This file defines a generic Result class used for encapsulating responses, including status, payload, and cache directives, within a larger Java-based project possibly related to HTTP services or messaging.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A generic class representing an HTTP response with status, payload, and optional cache directives, capable of creating event bus messages with response data.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns the optional caching directive associated with the response.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload contained in the response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates an error.

methods.name: from (static, int, IntFunction)
methods.description: Creates a response instance using a status code and a supplier function.

methods.name: from (static, int)
methods.description: Creates a generic Result instance with the given status, with null payload and no cache directives.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage response based on the request, setting JSON payload and cache directives as applicable.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Builds a string representation helper including status, cache directives, and payload.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Result object.
